text:
```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 10 * * *'  # 10:00 UTC daily
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  trivy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: "api.github.com,api.github.com:443,registry-1.docker.io,registry-1.docker.io:443"
          egress-policy: audit
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true
          policy: default

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Build Docker image
        run: |
          docker build -t opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest .

      - name: Trivy vulnerability scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: image
          image-ref: opentelemetry-mcp-server:latest
          ignore-unfixed: true
          severity: HIGH,CRITICAL
          exit-code: 1
```
